letter_verdict: By the letter of c7f4fac the result is SCALE-CONTINGENT: per_key_loo beats deadline_only at kv=56 ms by +0.91 s. That is the criterion's stated trigger and it is reported as such.
substance_verdict: The margin is not distinguishable from zero. +0.91 s is 0.46% of the 197.7 s deadline utility, its task-clustered 95% interval is [-1.71, +3.64] and only 74.4% of bootstrap draws are positive. The sign is also inconsistent across cells: per_key_loo wins at 56 ms, loses at 100 and 160; best_constant loses at 56 and 100, wins at 160 by +1.5 s. Inconsistent signs at sub-1% magnitudes are the signature of noise, not an effect. No arm reliably beats the deadline at any per-request scale.
the_substantive_finding: The BUDGET ITSELF collapses at per-request scale. As a fraction of deadline utility it is 9.2% at kv=56, 11.2% at 100 and 16.6% at 160, against 88.9% at 3500 and 84.8% at 5000. The large budget that motivated six iterations of this lane is largely a scale artifact.
mechanism: At kv=56 ms, 28.8% of calls outlive the threshold and nearly all of them have L far above 2*kv = 112 ms, so the deadline already fires with enough remaining time to hide the entire swap and incurs almost no exposure. The band kv<L<2kv where all budget lives holds only 2.2% of calls. At kv=5000 ms only 4.8% of calls are long, but the band calls carry exposure close to a full swap each, which is what inflates the batch-scale budget. The budget is therefore large exactly when the swap is large relative to tool durations, and that is the batch-eviction regime, not the per-request one.
scope_fact_worth_carrying: The campaign grid never includes the per-request scale. One request at the measured p50 context of 30900 tokens swaps in about 56 ms; the grid starts at 500 ms, nine requests' worth, and its headline cells are 62 and 89 requests' worth. The headline cells additionally lie outside the measured swap-out range of 238 to 1071 ms.
limitations: The per-request kv values pair a measured bandwidth with a measured context distribution; that pairing is mine and is not itself a measured quantity.
Only cmd_depth_4 per-key and a single fitted constant were re-run; the key ladder was not repeated at the new cells.
PREMISE unchanged: forced eviction; with no memory pressure every arm scores zero; Fresh-277 cannot exhibit contention; hidden-swap milliseconds, not wall clock.
